text:
Eloise: Heads up - found a weird billing/attribution case in canary where provisional tokens were confirmed but attributed to the wrong tenant after a retry/fallback.
Ben: whoa, cross-tenant? paste a scrubbed trace pls
Eloise: sanitized excerpt below. tenant_a made request but confirm shows tenant_b in ledger.
Eloise: ```
2026-03-26T02:11:02Z req=zz-19 route=us-east-1 tenant=acme client_session=cs-19 toolcall_id=tc-19 provisional=900 truncated_at=890
2026-03-26T02:11:05Z client retried -> routed to us-west-2 req=zz-19 tenant=acme client_session=cs-19 toolcall_id=tc-19 provisional=900
2026-03-26T02:11:10Z ledger_confirm: confirmed_tokens=1800 tenant=beta-corp finalizer=us-west-2
```
Chang: that log line is suspicious - confirmed tenant != request tenant. Might be a routing tag leak or a metadata mutation downstream during the handoff.
Maya: Could be a bug in the gateway when it gossips route metadata; we recently added a cached tenant-tag optimization to speed routing decisions. If cached metadata is stale it could apply the wrong tenant tag on retry.
Ben: If ledger finalization only uses the route-attached tenant tag and not the original request identity, confirmation could be mis-attributed. This is high-severity and must be fixed quickly.
Eloise: Agreed. Short-term remediation: 1) add an alert for any confirmed_tokens where confirmed_tenant != ingress_tenant within 1h window, 2) run immediate reconcile to move charges back and notify finance + affected customers.
Chang: I'll add a temporary guard in the router: always carry original_ingress_tenant in X-RW-Ingress-Tenant header and make ledger finalizer prefer it over route cache. Also add an integrity check that rejects confirmations if mismatch and write to audit log.
Maya: I'll roll back the tenant-cache optimization on the gateway canary until we have a patch.
Ben: Telemetry: emit provisional_origin={ingress_tenant, route, host}, and confirmed_event should include ingress_tenant and finalizer_tenant fields. Console should have a new card: "tenant attribution conflicts" with example traces.
Eloise: Ops plan: add Grafana alert for any non-zero daily count of tenant attribution conflicts and a higher-severity on >3 in 24h. Also create a billing ticket to proactively refund any mis-attributed charges.
Chang: For long-term: we need immutability of request identity across routing (flow-id + ingress_tenant baked into signing) and unit tests verifying that metadata cannot be overwritten by route cache.
Maya: I'll open PR to remove the cache and add an e2e test that simulates metadata mutation during reroute.
Ben: Also add a canary dashboard metric for "requests_missing_ingress_tenant_header_pct" and "ingress_vs_finalizer_tenant_mismatch_rate".
opsbot: created BLG-2026-123 (billing-ops) and flagged @finance and @customer-support (auto)
Eloise: Owners: Chang -> router guard + header copy + audit log; Maya -> gateway rollback + e2e tests; Ben -> telemetry + console card + dashboard; Eloise -> billing liaison + reconcile job.
Chang: I'll push a hotfix to canary today and enable the integrity rejection in the finalizer behind a feature flag.
Maya: will revert the cache and run the e2e.
Ben: I'll add the console card + alert panels.
Eloise: thanks team. This explains the odd spike and possible customer noise. Please post PR links here and tag BLG-2026-123. :pray:
